synopsis: ISO/TC 127 is the ISO technical committee for earth-moving machinery [f15033]. Nearly every off-road standard covered by the booklet originates from this committee, including standards for collision systems, object detection, brakes, functional safety, autonomous machines and machine definitions [f15034]. Its ISO 21815 collision-system standard covers earth-moving machines defined in ISO 6165, underground mining machines per ISO 19296, and road-construction machines [f15140]. Despite this broad standards role, the booklet found no ISO/TC 127 study applying road-vehicle simulation methods to off-road machines; Chapter 2 specifically identifies OpenSCENARIO, ISO 34502 and the UNECE New Assessment/Test Method in this evidence gap [f15035, f1698].

relations.note: Both report no ISO/TC 127 study transferring road-vehicle simulation methods to off-road machines.
Details the machine categories covered by ISO 21815, one of the committee's listed standards.
